reason: A provides the clearer, physically established, and decisively testable mechanism: a temperature- and rate-dependent slip-to-twinning transition linked to twin density and work hardening. B relies on vaguely defined “transient deformation bands” as strain homogenizers, makes an unsupported claim that Co removal causes this behavior, and largely extrapolates the critical-defect-density sequence already proposed for the Cantor alloy.
